purpose: Insist on a repeated message or address someone with exasperation.
keywords: Plain clause + ってば / ったら; person + ったら
I told you not to touch it.
Dad is looking for his glasses again, honestly.
formation: Plain clause + ってば / ったら; person + ったら
mistake: It can sound pushy; avoid it as a polite reminder to a stranger.
